overview: Barbados is an island country in the eastern Caribbean, the most easterly of the Caribbean islands. Its capital is Bridgetown. Barbados became independent from the United Kingdom in 1966, and in 2021 it became a republic, replacing the British monarch with its own president. It is known for cricket, rum and its beaches.

geography.text: Barbados is a fairly flat island made mostly of coral limestone, with gentle hills rising in the centre. The calm west coast faces the Caribbean Sea and has sandy beaches, while the rougher east coast faces the open Atlantic. Coral reefs surround much of the island.
